item.title: CT Democrats flex muscle with emergency legislation
item.description: Two “emergency-certified” bills crafted by the Connecticut General Assembly’s Democratic super-majorities sped Wednesday night to passage in the Senate after a partisan election-year debate over policies, process and power. One […]

item.title: 🔒 Philadelphia-based firm buys Wallingford trucking terminal for $3.6M
item.description: A Philadelphia real estate investor has acquired a Wallingford trucking terminal for $3.6 million, according to local land records.

item.title: New Jersey developers complete 117-unit apartment complex in Bethel
item.description: Two New Jersey-based developers have completed construction of a 117-unit apartment complex in Bethel, adding to the town’s rental housing inventory after a multi-year development effort.

item.title: 🔒 Investment firms pay $76.1M for 432-unit apartment complex in Windsor
item.description: A partnership of real estate investment firms has paid $76.1 million for the Rivers Bend Condos complex in Windsor, marking one of the largest suburban Hartford multifamily deals in recent years.

item.title: Hartford Federal Credit Union expands membership into Litchfield County
item.description: Hartford Federal Credit Union has received federal approval to expand its membership eligibility into much of Litchfield County.

item.title: 🔒 CT job openings declined in December as hiring activity rose
item.description: Connecticut employers posted fewer job openings in December, while hiring and separations both increased, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

item.title: 🔒 CT DMV’s newest license plate honors Army’s ‘Borinqueneers’
item.description: The state Department of Motor Vehicles on Thursday unveiled a new specialty license plate honoring the Army’s 65th Infantry Regiment, a storied unit known as the Borinqueneers.

item.title: 🔒 CT firearms manufacturer Sturm Ruger faces proxy fight with European investor
item.description: Southport-based Sturm, Ruger & Co. is facing a boardroom challenge from its largest shareholder, which is seeking to reshape the firearms manufacturer’s leadership and strategy.

item.title: 🔒 Affordable housing complex with 41 units approved in Newington
item.description: The Newington Town Plan and Zoning Commission on Wednesday unanimously approved a 41-unit affordable housing development at 103 Louis St., clearing the way for a Cromwell-based developer’s second affordable housing project in town.
